title: When Steering Fails in Latent Reasoning: A Latent-to-Language Transition Gap
abstract: arXiv:2609.21662v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Activation steering has become a widely used approach for controlling language models during explicit chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning, motivating its extension to latent CoT. However, we find that steering continuous thoughts produces substantially weaker effects on subsequent language generation than steering explicit CoT, even when the hidden representations are moved by comparable amounts. We first show that task information remains identifiable in continuous thoughts. Hence, we hypothesize a \textbf{latent-to-language transition gap}, in which an intervention effect in latent space fails to transfer to language generation. Two further results support this hypothesis: the output distribution changes abruptly at the transition boundary, and task-related directions exert much weaker bidirectional control in latent CoT than in explicit CoT. translated_title: 当潜空间推理中的引导失效时：一个从潜空间到语言的过渡鸿沟
translated_abstract: 激活引导已成为在显式思维链推理过程中控制语言模型的一种广泛使用的方法，这促使研究者将其扩展到潜思维链。然而，我们发现，与引导显式思维链相比，引导连续思维对后续语言生成的影响要弱得多，即使隐藏表示被移动了相当的幅度。我们首先证明任务信息在连续思维中仍然可以识别。因此，我们假设存在一个“从潜空间到语言的过渡鸿沟”，即潜空间中的干预效果无法传递到语言生成。两个进一步的实验结果支持了这一假设：输出分布在过渡边界处发生突变，且任务相关方向在潜思维链中的双向控制能力远弱于显式思维链。这些发现表明，过渡接口是评估和设计潜推理引导方法的核心目标。
tldr: 该研究揭示了潜思维链推理中存在“潜空间到语言的过渡鸿沟”——对连续思维的激活引导难以像显式思维链那样有效传递到语言生成，并将这一过渡接口确立为评估和设计潜推理引导方法的关键切入点。
